description: Check whether an address has the right format for one asset. Use it on both addresses before get_swap_page_link or create_swap. Format only: it does not check who owns the address, whether it is in use, or whether an exchange needs a memo; when the asset uses an extra id the response names it (extraIdName). A 0x… address can belong to Ethereum, BNB Smart Chain, Polygon or Base: ask which network before choosing the asset. With mode=private and side=to the receiving address is checked at the provider that will pay it.

address.description: the address to check, as the person gave it

asset.description: asset slug the address belongs to, e.g. usdt-trc20

mode.description: private with side=to: the receiving address is checked at the provider that will pay it

side.description: which side of the swap the address is on (default from)

name: validate_address
title: Validate an address
